description: This file defines a static class 'ManageNavPages' that provides helper methods and properties for managing navigation page states within an ASP.NET Core MVC view context, specifically for the management pages of a web application.

classes.name: ManageNavPages
classes.description: A static utility class that provides navigation state helpers for managing active page indicators in views.

methods.name: ActivePageKey
methods.description: A property returning the key used to store the active page in view data.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Property returning the string identifier for the 'Index' page.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: Property returning the string identifier for the 'ChangePassword' page.

methods.name: ExternalLogins
methods.description: Property returning the string identifier for the 'ExternalLogins' page.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthentication
methods.description: Property returning the string identifier for the 'TwoFactorAuthentication' page.

methods.name: PageNavClass
methods.description: Determines the CSS class ('active' or empty) for a navigation link based on the current active page.

methods.name: AddActivePage
methods.description: Method that assigns the active page identifier to view data for highlighting in the UI.

methods.name: IndexNavClass
methods.description: Returns 'active' if the current page is 'Index'; otherwise, an empty string.

methods.name: ChangePasswordNavClass
methods.description: Returns 'active' if the current page is 'ChangePassword'; otherwise, an empty string.

methods.name: ExternalLoginsNavClass
methods.description: Returns 'active' if the current page is 'ExternalLogins'; otherwise, an empty string.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthenticationNavClass
methods.description: Returns 'active' if the current page is 'TwoFactorAuthentication'; otherwise, an empty string.
